data.one_liner: Adds a configurable debug overlay with tools like logs, media query info, and theme overrides.
data.what_it_does: Provides a central overlay that can be opened in debug mode to view app diagnostics and change settings at runtime. Tools are registered as DebugTool instances and displayed in a draggable bubble or expanded sheet.
use_when: You need quick access to runtime diagnostics without leaving the app
You want to toggle debug features like logs or media overrides on the fly
avoid_when: You prefer a separate logging or analytics solution
weaknesses: Only active in debug mode by default

alternatives.name: inspector
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides widget inspection and diagnostics without custom overlay

alternatives.name: talker_logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: Rich logging with built‑in UI for viewing logs
